#
# The §8 type scale and the §7.1 icon sizes are real here, not stand-ins: S-1
# measured with built-in Montserrat and said so, leaving the glyph cache of a
# bpp:4 font untested. That cache is a render-time cost, which makes it exactly
# this spike's business. The sources are generated by tools/fonts/generate.sh
# into firmware/main/assets/ and are gitignored, so the build fails loudly here
# rather than silently falling back to a built-in face.
#
set(SLATE_ASSETS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../firmware/main/assets")
file(GLOB SLATE_FONT_SRCS "${SLATE_ASSETS}/*.c")
if(NOT SLATE_FONT_SRCS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "No fonts in ${SLATE_ASSETS}. Run tools/fonts/generate.sh before building.")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "s2_main.c" "s2_board.c" "s2_scene.c" ${SLATE_FONT_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES json esp_timer esp_lcd driver esp_wifi nvs_flash esp_psram esp_mm
)

#
# Build-time knobs. Each run in docs/spikes/s2.md is one combination, and every
# one of them is a separate build rather than a runtime switch, because the
# framebuffer count and the bounce buffer are fixed when the panel is installed.
#
#   -DS2_NUM_FBS=1|2   framebuffers the RGB driver allocates (§6.2's question)
#   -DS2_BOUNCE=0|1    bounce buffer in internal SRAM; 0 is the negative control
#   -DS2_TILES=12|20   tiles per page: 12 saturates the §3.2 grid, 20 overloads it
#   -DS2_RADIO=0|1     WiFi PHY active without joining a network — §6.2's
#                      artifact case. See the header of s2_main.c.
#
# The LVGL refresh period is not a knob here but an sdkconfig overlay, because
# it is a Kconfig value rather than a compile definition:
#
#   -DSDKCONFIG=build-x/sdkconfig -DSDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.refr10"
#
# The explicit -DSDKCONFIG is not optional. SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS is consulted only
# when no sdkconfig exists yet, so without it a "variant" silently rebuilds the
# previous configuration and reports identical numbers — the trap that produced
# two false results in S-3 (docs/spikes/s3.md, "The measurement rule").
#
# Blind label for the §6.2 bounce-buffer comparison — see s2_scene.c.
if(DEFINED S2_TAG_OVERRIDE)
    target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE S2_TAG_OVERRIDE=\"${S2_TAG_OVERRIDE}\")
endif()
foreach(knob S2_NUM_FBS S2_BOUNCE S2_TILES S2_RADIO S2_DRAW_LINES S2_VISUAL_SWITCH S2_VSYNC_GATE)
    if(DEFINED ${knob})
        target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE ${knob}=${${knob}})
    endif()
endforeach()
